Market today: The broader market saw a significant relief rally, with the Dow having its best day in 18 months after the Democratic sweep. However, this rally isn't explicitly tech-led, and your concentrated tech/chip names face ongoing sector-specific headwinds like a chip talent war and potential demand issues. 

Your holdings: SOXL (-70.33%), MUU (-48.29%), SPAL (-47.48%), SMCI (-32.54%), and SMH (-20.76%) are all in 'SELL' status, deeply in the red, and have already breached their listed stop levels. QQQI (-7.58%) is also in 'SELL' status and very close to its stop at 52. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on QQQI as it approaches its stop. Also, watch for any clear signs of stabilization or further weakness in your core tech/chip holdings, especially the leveraged ones.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your deeply underwater, leveraged positions to protect your capital.
plays: Review all 'SELL' positions where current price is below the listed stop (SMH, SMCI, PLTU, MUU, SOXL, SPAL); these stops have been breached, consider trimming or exiting.
Respect the QQQI stop at 52; be prepared to act if it hits.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
